I would require 12” minimum penetration because FBI research shows that is the #1 contributor to success. Then I would consider recoil and magazine capacity. Assuming those are the same, I would calculate the cylindrical volume displaced by each diameter and depth and choose the option that displaces the most volume. If it’s still a close call, I lean towards penetration both because FBI says it’s #1 but also because there may be things like bones or glass or heavy clothing in the way which must be penetrated. Bones are not accounted for in ballistics gelatin.
